The color of the pages is a light yellow. I used gel pens, ball point pens, as well as a highlighter on these sheets and there was no smudging, bleeding, or smearing. It has come in handy when making shopping lists, jotting down thoughts, and general to-do lists. They adhere well to any surface without leaving any stickiness or residue behind. Important to note these are not post-it note size, they are significantly larger. Overall, these pads are a great concept and has good quality paper.
